notes: REF-BM-02: metadata endpoint fetches only title+description; no favicon or preview image collected. REF-BM-06: submit always unshifts a new bookmark with no duplicate-url check/convergence to editing. REF-BM-07: cards show title/desc/tags but use a generated colored letter avatar, no real favicon. REF-BM-10: tags are a plain comma input with no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-14: search is a plain substring match on joined fields; no #tag parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag, no unread view, no mark-as-read. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-23: 'Note' field is stored as plain description and rendered escaped/plain-text; no markdown authoring or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot and no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundles (saved filter combinations). REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: only an ephemeral sort control (REF-BM-22); no persisted default sort, displayed-items, or font-size settings.
